_comment: Security headers autumn-web's middleware stamps on every origin response.
The edge capsule serves exactly what the handler produced — the origin's
middleware stack does not run there — so without this list an edge-served
page would carry fewer protections than the same page from the origin.
That is a security regression, not a cosmetic difference, so the Cloudflare
shim restores them on every response it serves.
This file is the single source of truth for that list. Both sides read it:
edge/worker/src/index.js   stamps these on every edge-served response
tests/edge_conformance.rs  asserts the origin emits exactly these and no
others beyond what the handler itself sets
So a framework upgrade that adds a fifth header fails the Rust test and
names the file to edit, rather than quietly shipping a weaker edge lane.
